info.title: find-job-helper
info.description: Command-line CV generator for FindJobHelper workspaces.

commands.name: example-config
commands.description: Print an example JSON CV selection configuration.

commands.name: list-tags
commands.description: List all tags available for CV selection.

options.name: --experience-database
options.description:
<TEXT>
Path to a DLL containing exactly one public experience database provider.

commands.name: new-config
commands.description: Write an example configuration to config.json.

options.name: --experience-database
options.description:
<TEXT>
Path to a DLL containing exactly one public experience database provider.

options.name: --config
options.description:
<TEXT>
Path to the JSON CV selection configuration.

options.name: --output-directory
options.description:
<TEXT>            [.]
Destination directory for the generated artifact.

options.name: --output-format
options.description:
<CVOUTPUTFORMAT>  [Tex]
Output format: tex uses the LaTeX renderer and publishes a compiled PDF; md publishes clean Markdown.
Allowed values: tex, md

options.name: --debug
options.description: Override --output-format and publish both clean and annotated Markdown without compiling a PDF.

options.name: --open
options.description: Select the generated artifact after a successful generation.

options.name: --latex-bin-directory
options.description:
<TEXT>
Directory containing both latexmk and xelatex. Overrides FINDJOBHELPER_LATEX_BIN_DIRECTORY and automatic discovery.

options.name: --main-font
options.description:
<TEXT>
Installed LaTeX main font family. Overrides CV_MAIN_FONT; default: Liberation Serif.

options.name: --sans-font
options.description:
<TEXT>
Installed LaTeX sans-serif font family. Overrides CV_SANS_FONT; default: Liberation Sans.

options.name: --mono-font
options.description:
<TEXT>
Installed LaTeX monospaced font family. Overrides CV_MONO_FONT; default: Liberation Mono.
